title: Ironcrest Machinery Corporation: executive team and board
summary: The executive crisis team and board of a Rockford, Illinois machinery maker (three plants, a parts distribution center, a Form 8-K clock and a recovery plan with stated RTOs), with an exercise generated from its simulated plans: ransomware discovered on a Thursday afternoon at quarter end, a ransom demand and a data leak threat, a materiality call and the filing.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Ironcrest Machinery Corporation, its customers, lenders, insurer, auditor, advisers and people are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/ironcrest-governance/SOURCES.md. Exercise aid, not legal advice.

scenarios.title: Six Days Out
scenarios.summary: On the last Thursday of the quarter, ransomware encrypts the Rockford data center and the MES, stops shipping at the Joliet distribution center and threatens to publish stolen drawings and employee data; the executive team and board must declare the crisis, decide on the ransom, determine materiality and file, and recover against the stated RTOs.
